ReasoningScratchPad: Investigating high CPU and memory growth pattern in web application
ClassificationReason: Performance issue with resource leak characteristics
Title: Web App High CPU - Memory Leak Investigation
SystemDesignKnowledge: ASP.NET Core web application with caching layer
InitialSymptoms: Users reporting slow response times, monitoring shows high CPU
SymptomsObserved: High CPU usage at 95%, increasing memory consumption over time, slow response times
StepsFollowed:
1. Monitored memory usage patterns
2. Analyzed heap dumps
3. Identified memory leak in caching layer
4. Deployed fix with proper object disposal
RootCause: Memory leak in application code - cached objects not being disposed properly
Pitfalls: Avoid restarting app without identifying root cause - leak will recur
